lines.say: Sold by his own brothers, and years later he saved their lives. This is Joseph!
Joseph's father gave him a special colorful coat. And his brothers got jealous.
So jealous, that they threw him into a dry well.
Then they sold him to traders on camels, heading for Egypt.
In Egypt, Joseph worked hard and never gave up.
One day, Pharaoh had a strange dream about fat cows and thin cows. Only Joseph could explain it.
Seven good years, then seven hungry years, Joseph said. So Pharaoh made him a ruler!
When the hungry years came, his brothers traveled to Egypt for food, and bowed to him.
They didn't recognize him. But Joseph recognized them!
Instead of being angry, he told them who he was, and gave them a big hug.
Then their old father Jacob came to Egypt too.
The whole family was together again. Would you forgive like Joseph? Tell me in the comments!
